assessments.basis: Exact pinned replay and axiom audit; no ControlArena premise check
assessments.scope: BudgetedObservation.dual_certificate in the pinned Lean 4.33.0 environment

formal_statement: R_p >= A - lambda*b - sum_i max(0, a_i - t_i - lambda*m_i), under the declaration's finite-model hypotheses

open_obligations: supply μ, U, T, b and same-population interpretation before any theorem application
in.rationale: The checked dual certificate uses this policy form and further requires finite distribution, potential-event and budget data. Adjacency here is a research lead; the ELK model is not an instance of the risk theorem.
in.scope: discovery of the pinned monitoring risk theorem from a shared policy-form question

open_obligations: audit exact runtime monitor input against formal O
classify private randomness and conditional independence
freeze run distribution and route configuration
out.rationale: A theorem about O may be relevant, but the materialized request, randomness, route, and run population have not been shown to satisfy its premises.
out.scope: candidate Rogue Eval single-decision monitor at the pinned source revision

open_obligations: freeze an attack snapshot sampling law
map actual monitor requests and deferral decisions to O and p(O)
measure or justify the attack-population observation-fiber masses
out.rationale: The theorem budget definition is exact in the formal model, but its mu and O have not been mapped to a frozen candidate-system episode distribution.
out.scope: future frozen Rogue Eval attack snapshots versus theorem mass mu

text: For finite hidden contexts and a policy under an expected deferral budget in the same attack distribution, the pinned Lean declaration proves the dual lower-bound inequality. Formal checking is local to this statement.
title: Budgeted observation lower-bound theorem
